# nsgame — Full Context

> Session-wallet prediction market on Solana. Users open a per-tab session
> keypair, fund it from their main wallet, and place 1-click bets on whether
> a price feed crosses a threshold by a settlement time. Resolution is on
> chain. Payouts are parimutuel.

Status: devnet only. Mainnet has not been deployed. Any address, fee, or
parameter that disagrees with this file is either out of date or fabricated.

Repo: this monorepo, `nsgame/` directory.

---

## Product

A market is a binary question: at a fixed settlement time, will the
referenced price feed sit above or below a baseline-derived threshold? Each
market has:

- a `source_id` — the on-chain registry entry for the price feed
- a `close_time` — bets stop being accepted
- a `settlement_time` — the point the resolver compares against the baseline
- a `threshold_bps` — signed integer; for binary price markets it expresses
  basis-point movement, but the field is repurposed for non-price markets
  (over/under integer targets, presence/survival flags). Field name persists
  out of stubbornness; see `nsgame/lib/solana/catalog.ts`.

Bets settle parimutuel: the losing side's stake (minus fees) is split
proportionally among winners. Winners call `claim` to withdraw.

Bounds enforced by the program:

- `threshold_bps != 0`
- `|threshold_bps| <= 10_000` (the cap may be lifted for tube/integer sources)
- `close_time - now >= 10s`
- `settlement_time - close_time >= 10s`
- `settlement_time - now <= 30 days`

---

## Solana

- Cluster: devnet
- Genesis hash (used by the faucet to refuse non-devnet clusters): `EtWTRABZaYq6iMfeYKouRu166VU2xqa1wcaWoxPkrZBG`
- Program ID: `DQwMnwQGYuLDvciSFZNgUvcHkA3Buyhk3ejgbACvSydA`
- Program name: `prediction_market` (Anchor 0.1.0)
- Stake mint (devnet): `5BNaj6SeidyLp9PKRFTEKCTGsww9SQmsTp7yEqgHiEkT` — 6 decimals
- IDL: `nsgame/lib/solana/idl/prediction_market.json`

### Instructions

| Name | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `initialize_config` | Bootstrap `GlobalConfig` — admin, fee vault, fee bps, pause flag |
| `propose_admin` / `accept_admin` | Two-step admin handover |
| `set_fee_bps` | Update protocol fee |
| `set_pause` | Halt new bets without freezing exits/claims |
| `propose_oracle_signers` / `activate_oracle_signers` | Rotate the oracle signer set |
| `upsert_source` | Register or update a price feed source |
| `place_bet` | Open or extend a YES/NO position on a market |
| `exit_bet` | Withdraw before close (subject to program rules) |
| `batch_bets` | Place multiple bets in a single transaction |
| `close_market` | Snapshot the close-time baseline price |
| `resolve_market` | Compute outcome from settlement-time price vs. baseline |
| `admin_force_resolve` | Operator escape hatch when the resolver cannot complete |
| `claim` | Withdraw winnings on a resolved market |
| `withdraw_fees` | Admin sweep of the fee vault |

### Accounts

`GlobalConfig`, `Market`, `OracleConfig`, `Position`, `Source`.

### PDAs

| Seed | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `config` | `GlobalConfig` |
| `fee_vault` | Protocol fee custody |
| `source` + `u32 LE source_id` | `Source` registry entry |

Market and `Position` PDAs are derived from market parameters and owner —
see `deriveMarketPda` and related helpers in
`nsgame/lib/solana/predictionMarket.ts`.

### Session wallets

The frontend uses per-tab session keypairs (see
`nsgame/lib/solana/SessionContext.tsx`) so users can place 1-click bets
without re-signing every transaction. The session is funded from the user's
main wallet (Phantom, Backpack, etc. via UnifiedWalletKit). The Anchor
provider abstraction is bypassed because session wallets are not adapter-
compliant — instructions are built directly with `TransactionInstruction`.

---

## HTTP API

Base: `https://nsgame.io` (when deployed) or `http://localhost:3000` in dev.

### Faucet

- `POST /api/faucet/mint`
- Body: `{ "address": "<base58 pubkey>" }`
- Mints 100 stake-mint tokens (6 decimals) to the wallet's ATA
- 60-second per-IP cooldown
- Refuses any cluster whose genesis hash is not devnet

### Indexed reads

The indexer Postgres lives on VPS 3, bound to `127.0.0.1`. Routes return
empty arrays when `POSTGRES_URL` is unset — local dev keeps working.

- `GET /api/positions/{wallet}` — every bet by a wallet, joined with close,
  resolve, and claim events. Each position carries a state:
  `open`, `settling`, `resolved-won`, `resolved-lost`, `claimed`.
- `GET /api/markets/{pda}/bets` — recent `BetPlaced` events for a market.
- `GET /api/events/recent` — recent program events across all markets.
- `GET /api/events/stream` — SSE feed of program events.
- `GET /api/events/history/{owner}` — historical events for a wallet.

### Price feeds

Proxied through the data-node (`DATA_NODE_URL`, defaults to `http://localhost:8200`).

- `GET /api/pairs/{pairIndex}/price`
- `GET /api/pairs/{pairIndex}/history`
- `GET /api/sources/{id}/price`
- `GET /api/sources/{id}/history`

### Pass-through

- `GET /api/dn/{...path}` — streams to `${DATA_NODE_URL}/{path}`. Used for
  SSE that Next.js rewrites would buffer and break.
- `/api/backend/{...path}` — pass-through to `BACKEND_URL`. Most surfaces
  formerly served here belong to the prior fork; treat them as untrusted
  unless you can point at the file that proves they exist.

---

## What this product is not

This codebase was forked from `generalmarket`, an EVM/Arbitrum-Orbit ETF +
prediction-market protocol. That product had ITPs, BLS-signed oracle
batches, an Authorized Participant pipeline, USDC bridging, Vision data
sources. None of that is part of nsgame. References to ITP, Vision, AP,
Orbit L3, Chain ID `111222333`, USDC at 18 decimals, BLS signatures, or
`generalmarket.io` predate the rewrite and should be treated as bugs.

If something in the repo says otherwise, the file is stale. Trust the
program IDL, the route handlers, and this document — in that order.
